author: /root/daily_operation_review
qualification: Independent multilingual model review of the entire candidate and each corrected span against the English final source; reviewer did not author or modify this locale candidate. This is not human native-language certification.

findings.message: The reviewed German distinguishes Körpermaße, Kleidungsmaße and a flat garment width from Körperumfang.
The women, child-growth and cart guidance retains the source conditions and avoids blanket sizing or stretch claims.
No material defect found in the corrected spans. Existing unrelated introductory wording, unchanged headings and table row labels were preserved as required rather than broadly rewritten.

limits: Frozen local candidate review only; no Shopify source mutation or external browser navigation by this reviewer.
Per-locale route arrivals, rendered mobile layout and deployed-value/stale-flag verification remain root responsibilities.
This review qualifies the corrected meanings and bounded preservation; it does not certify every legacy sentence as polished copy or claim audience acceptance.
